question:
**Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.**

I have ____ in love with her.
solution:
The correct answer is '**fallen**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**fallen**" is used to indicate that someone has suddenly become deeply enamored or in love. (गिरना, प्रेम में पड़ना)
 
• It is a common idiomatic expression to say "fallen in love."
 
• The other options: "**crashed**," "**docked**," and "**slide**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I have fallen__ in love with her.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Crashed (टकराना)**: means to collide violently with an obstacle.
 
• **Docked (गोदी में लाना)**: means to bring a ship or boat into a dock.
 
• **Slide (फिसलना)**: means to move smoothly over a surface.
